successCriteria.description: getBalanceForEmployee returns an ARRAY of balance entries (one per effective leave-type policy), never a single object — even when exactly one policy is in effect.
Each returned entry exposes leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd, entitledDays, usedDays, pendingDays, and a computed available equal to entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays.
A leave type with an effective policy but no balance row for the current period yields a zeroed entry (entitled/used/pending/available = 0) — never omitted and never a NotFoundError.

listEffectivePolicies returns at most one policy per leaveTypeCode: ACTIVE status, effectiveFrom <= asOf, effectiveTo null or >= asOf, latest effectiveFrom winning on ties — so a superseded policy never produces duplicate entries for the same type.
The balance read endpoint resolves the actor from request.user (never a client-supplied id) and rejects a missing/invalid actor with UnauthorizedError.

constraints: getBalanceForEmployee is read-only: it must not open a transaction (no uow.withTransaction) and must not perform any writes.

The current period must be derived via the shared periodContaining(employee.hireDate, policy.accrualPeriodMonths, new Date()) from src/shared/date/accrual.ts — no local re-derivation of accrual arithmetic.
listEffectivePolicies must reuse the existing IPolicyRepository.findAll() — no new repository method, no SQL inside the service, and no balance -> leave-type module dependency.
The balance route must resolve the actor with a resolveActor helper matching leave.routes.ts (role membership enforced at the API boundary, GP-005) and map errors via sendError.
outOfScope: Registering balanceRoutes in src/app.ts (owned by Sub-phase 3c) — balanceRoutes is exported but not mounted at runtime in this sub-phase.
Smoke-check assertions for GET /balances/me and unit tests for getBalanceForEmployee / balance routes (owned by Phase 5).
Extracting src/shared/date/accrual.ts and refactoring LeaveService to use it (owned by Sub-phase 3a).
Consolidating the deferred private addMonths duplicate in BalanceService into src/shared/date/accrual.ts (deferred cleanup, not blocking).

entityInvariants.invariant: A read-only projection of a leave-type balance for the caller's current accrual period; available is always derived as entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays and never stored.
At most one policy is in effect per leaveTypeCode at any given date (ACTIVE, effectiveFrom <= asOf, effectiveTo null or >= asOf, latest effectiveFrom wins).

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller identity is resolved from the authenticated actor; the service receives the actor's id (never a client-supplied id).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Unknown employee -> NotFoundError; missing balance row -> zeroed entry (no error); read-only, no transaction.
Returns an empty array when no policy is in effect; never throws for an empty result.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: RBAC enforced at the API boundary via resolveActor (role membership in EmployeeRole); missing/invalid actor -> UnauthorizedError.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: AppError -> { error, code } with matching status; any other throw -> 500.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The current accrual period must be computed with the shared periodContaining helper (and its startOfUtcDay/addMonths UTC arithmetic), not a local copy.
The resolveActor helper must match the pattern in leave.routes.ts (extract request.user, validate non-empty id and EmployeeRole membership, throw UnauthorizedError).
The sendError helper must map AppError to { error, code } with the correct status and any other throw to 500, matching leave.routes.ts.
listEffectivePolicies must call the existing IPolicyRepository.findAll() and filter in application code — no new repository method and no SQL in the service.
Balance lookups must use IBalanceRepository.findByKey(employeeId, leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd), preserving the at-most-one-row-per-key invariant.

integrationPoints.why: Resolve the employee's hireDate to anchor the accrual period; NotFoundError propagates for an unknown employee.
Enumerate the effective leave-type policies (accrualPeriodMonths + leaveTypeCode) to derive one balance entry per type.
Single source of truth for accrual-period derivation shared with LeaveService.
Look up the balance row for the derived (employee, type, period) key; null -> zeroed entry.
